pins.notes: Terminal; non-polarized two-terminal 1206 chip, the datasheet gives no pin names or numbers.

layout_notes.text: Recommended pad layout (1206): P = 2.00 mm, S = 1.00 mm, W = 1.90 mm nominal (see drawing for dimension meaning). Termination matte tin-plated copper.
Reflow only (IR, vapor phase, hot air); not recommended for wave solder or direct immersion; paste thickness 0.20-0.25 mm; peak 260 C, 20-40 s within 5 C of peak; MSL 2a.
PTC behaviour depends on heat loss: keep it away from heat sources (it trips at about 125 C internal, p2) and avoid rigid potting over it (cautionary note 6).
May not suit circuits with large inductance: trip can create voltage spikes above Vmax (cautionary note 4). Intended for occasional faults, not repeated or prolonged faults (note 2).

gaps: Two-terminal non-polarized part: the datasheet gives no pin names or numbers; names '1'/'2' are a convention for symbol mapping.
IT is defined as the minimum trip current (p1 definitions) and is listed here as a min; the table column only says 'Trip Current IT, A'.
Hold-current derating (p3) is given as a typical table and curve 'for guidance only' (p2 note); no guaranteed IH at the board ambient.
No resistance value at operating temperature or after repeated trips beyond R1max (1 h after trip or after soldering, p1); post-trip resistance drift after the first hour is not specified.
Time-current curve (p2) is an image; only the single tabulated point (0.25 A, 1.50 s max) is extracted.
Equation E**2/Pd (p2) gives the apparent tripped resistance; E is the voltage across the tripped PTC (supply open-circuit voltage), not a part value, so no variables are mapped.
Marking code for 0ZCJ0005FF2E is 'C' (p3); body dimensions C 0.45-0.85 mm, D 0.10-0.75 mm (p3); length and width of the 1206 body are in a drawing not extracted as text.
Datasheet does not give the date beyond 'Apr2023' (p2 footer).
